indications: Phenylephrine Hydrochloride in 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection is indicated for increasing blood pressure in adults with clinically important hypotension resulting primarily from vasodilation in the setting of anesthesia.
contraindications: Do NOT dilute prior to administration ( 2.1 ) Dosing for Perioperative Hypotension Intravenous bolus administration: 50 mcg to 250 mcg ( 2.2 ) Intravenous continuous infusion: 0.5 mcg/kg/minute to 1.4 mcg/kg/minute titrated to effect ( 2.2 )
